coverage.description: Validates DDS magic/header sizes, dimensions, legacy/DX10 format identity, DX10 resource metadata, explicit full-mip policy, known block-compressed payload size, and narrow Skyrim generation compatibility policy.
known_gaps: does not decode pixels or inspect actual channel content
uncompressed and Texture3D payload byte-size validation remain incomplete
texture-role semantics such as normal/specular/environment masks require a later decoded-channel validator
coverage.denominator_probe: all declared DDS assets vs structurally parsed assets vs payload-size-checked block-compressed assets.

verification.version_probe: Microsoft DDS/DXGI definitions plus explicit Skyrim generation policy.
verification.output_readback: Validate typed invariant report; triangulate release assets with DirectXTex/CAO and runtime rendering where semantics matter.

ai.context_cost_notes: Cheap deterministic first-pass DDS oracle before heavier image decode or runtime rendering.

evidence.notes: Microsoft documents 128-byte base header, 148-byte DX10 header, header-size invariants, block-compressed layout and DXGI format identifiers.
